llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial loan assistance to minority community students from Karnataka who are pursuing graduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized foreign universities.
llm_fields.eligibility: The student must be a resident of Karnataka State, belong to a minority community (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, or Parsi), have secured at least 60% marks in the previous year, possess an offer letter from a foreign university, obtain the loan against mortgage of property (building/land) whose value is not less than the loan amount, and must not have received a scholarship from the Directorate of Minorities.
